lessons.title: 1.1 Introduction to Cloud Architecture & Monolith Deconstruction
lessons.description: Video walkthrough breaking monolithic systems into bounded contexts and decoupled microservices.
lessons.content_body:
## Architecture Overview
In this lecture, Dr. Sarah Mitchell walks through the transition strategy from legacy monolithic software into containerized microservices.

### Key Discussion Points:
1. **Domain-Driven Design (DDD)**: Establishing bounded contexts.
2. **Database Per Service**: Overcoming shared database traps.
3. **Data Consistency**: Eventual consistency versus ACID transactions.

> *Quote from lecture*: "A microservice architecture is an organizational solution disguised as a technical solution."

quiz_questions.question_text: Which operator in C returns the memory address of a variable?
quiz_questions.explanation: The ampersand (&) operator yields the memory address of its operand.

quiz_questions.question_text: What is the default return type of the main() function in modern ISO C standard?
quiz_questions.explanation: According to C99 and subsequent standards, main() must return an integer.

quiz_questions.question_text: Which dynamic memory allocation function in C initializes allocated memory bytes to zero?
quiz_questions.explanation: calloc() allocates contiguous memory and initializes all allocated bits to zero.

quiz_questions.question_text: What will sizeof(char) always evaluate to in any standard-compliant C compiler?
quiz_questions.explanation: By definition in the C specification, sizeof(char) is guaranteed to equal 1 byte.

quiz_questions.question_text: Which keyword is used to prevent modification of a variable value after its initialization?
quiz_questions.explanation: The const qualifier declares that a variable’s value is read-only after initialization.

quiz_questions.question_text: In C, what is the index of the first element in any array?
quiz_questions.explanation: C uses zero-based array indexing.

quiz_questions.question_text: What does the break statement do inside a switch-case block?
quiz_questions.explanation: break exits the switch block, preventing fall-through to consecutive cases.

quiz_questions.question_text: Which format specifier is used in printf() to print a pointer address in hexadecimal?
quiz_questions.explanation: %p is the standard format specifier for printing void pointer addresses.

quiz_questions.question_text: What character terminates a standard C string literal?
quiz_questions.explanation: C strings are contiguous null-terminated character sequences ending in \0.

quiz_questions.question_text: Which preprocessing directive is used to include header file contents in C?
quiz_questions.explanation: #include inserts the contents of the specified header file during preprocessing.

quiz_questions.question_text: Which built-in Python data structure is mutable and ordered?
quiz_questions.explanation: Lists in Python are mutable, ordered sequences.

quiz_questions.question_text: What keyword turns a normal function into a generator that yields values lazily?
quiz_questions.explanation: The yield keyword pauses function execution and returns a generator iterator.

quiz_questions.question_text: Which dunder method is invoked when an object is instantiated to initialize its state?
quiz_questions.explanation: __init__ is the initializer method called after instance creation.

quiz_questions.question_text: What is the time complexity of looking up a key in a standard Python dictionary (average case)?
quiz_questions.explanation: Python dictionaries use hash tables, providing O(1) average lookup time.

quiz_questions.question_text: Which Python statement is used to handle exceptions gracefully?
quiz_questions.explanation: Python uses try-except blocks for exception handling.

quiz_questions.question_text: What built-in function returns an iterator of tuples containing index and value?
quiz_questions.explanation: enumerate() takes an iterable and returns (index, element) pairs.

quiz_questions.question_text: Which symbol is used for variable positional arguments (*args) in function definitions?
quiz_questions.explanation: *args packs extra positional arguments into a tuple.

quiz_questions.question_text: In Python, what does the Global Interpreter Lock (GIL) primarily restrict in CPython?
quiz_questions.explanation: The GIL prevents multiple threads from executing Python bytecodes simultaneously.

quiz_questions.question_text: Which module in standard Python provides regular expression support?
quiz_questions.explanation: The standard library module re handles regular expression operations.

quiz_questions.question_text: What is the result of bool([]) in Python?
quiz_questions.explanation: Empty collections in Python evaluate to False in boolean contexts.

quiz_questions.question_text: What is the worst-case time complexity of QuickSort?
quiz_questions.explanation: QuickSort has O(n^2) worst case when unbalanced partitions occur.

quiz_questions.question_text: Which data structure is primarily used in Breadth-First Search (BFS) graph traversal?
quiz_questions.explanation: BFS uses a FIFO queue to explore nodes level-by-level.

quiz_questions.question_text: In an AVL tree, what is the maximum allowable absolute difference in height between subtrees of any node?
quiz_questions.explanation: AVL balance factor balance must be in {-1, 0, 1}.

quiz_questions.question_text: Which algorithm finds single-source shortest paths in weighted directed graphs without negative edges?
quiz_questions.explanation: Dijkstra's algorithm computes non-negative shortest path distances efficiently.

quiz_questions.question_text: What principle does a standard Call Stack follow?
quiz_questions.explanation: Stacks operate strictly under Last In, First Out semantics.

quiz_questions.question_text: Which tree traversal visits the root node between the left and right subtrees?
quiz_questions.explanation: In-order traversal visits left subtree, current node, then right subtree.

quiz_questions.question_text: What is the time complexity of inserting into a max-heap of n elements?
quiz_questions.explanation: Heap insertion involves placing at bottom and bubbling up at most tree height O(log n).

quiz_questions.question_text: Which algorithm design paradigm does MergeSort exemplify?
quiz_questions.explanation: MergeSort divides the array into halves, sorts them recursively, and merges.

quiz_questions.question_text: In a hash table, what strategy resolves collisions by searching for the next empty bucket sequentially?
quiz_questions.explanation: Linear probing searches consecutive slots until an empty slot is encountered.

quiz_questions.question_text: What is the minimum number of edges in a connected undirected graph with V vertices?
quiz_questions.explanation: A connected graph with V vertices requires at least V - 1 edges (spanning tree).

quiz_questions.question_text: In relational database theory, which Normal Form guarantees the absence of transitive functional dependencies on candidate keys?
quiz_questions.explanation: 3NF requires that no non-prime attribute is transitively dependent on any candidate key.

quiz_questions.question_text: What is the primary objective of a Write-Ahead Log (WAL) in database transaction management?
quiz_questions.explanation: WAL ensures that changes are logged to non-volatile storage before being written to disk data pages.

quiz_questions.question_text: Which disk indexing tree structure is guaranteed to be completely height-balanced with leaves stored at equal depth?
quiz_questions.explanation: B+ Trees maintain uniform depth for all leaf pages, ensuring predictable block read times.

quiz_questions.question_text: In SQL, which clause filters rows produced by an aggregate GROUP BY query?
quiz_questions.explanation: HAVING applies filter predicates to aggregated group results, whereas WHERE filters individual rows.

quiz_questions.question_text: Which ACID property guarantees that all operations within a transaction are completed or none are applied?
quiz_questions.explanation: Atomicity enforces all-or-nothing execution semantics.

quiz_questions.question_text: What isolation level prevents dirty reads, non-repeatable reads, and phantom reads simultaneously?
quiz_questions.explanation: Serializable is the highest isolation level and prevents all concurrency anomalies.

quiz_questions.question_text: Which join type returns all rows from the left table and matched rows from the right table?
quiz_questions.explanation: LEFT OUTER JOIN keeps all records from the left relation, filling missing right columns with NULL.

quiz_questions.question_text: In Boyce-Codd Normal Form (BCNF), for every functional dependency X -> Y, what must X be?
quiz_questions.explanation: BCNF requires that the determinant X in every non-trivial functional dependency is a superkey.

quiz_questions.question_text: What concurrency control protocol divides transaction execution into growing and shrinking phases?
quiz_questions.explanation: 2PL ensures conflict serializability by acquiring all locks before releasing any lock.

quiz_questions.question_text: Which database index type works best for low-cardinality columns (e.g. gender, status)?
quiz_questions.explanation: Bitmap indexes use bit arrays for distinct values and are highly effective for low-cardinality fields.

quiz_questions.question_text: What hardware component accelerates virtual-to-physical address translation in modern CPUs?
quiz_questions.explanation: The TLB is a dedicated hardware associative cache for page table entries.

quiz_questions.question_text: Which CPU scheduling algorithm gives priority to processes with the shortest remaining execution time?
quiz_questions.explanation: SRTF is the preemptive version of Shortest Job First scheduling.

quiz_questions.question_text: What condition causes thrashing in an operating system?
quiz_questions.explanation: Thrashing occurs when the total working set exceeds physical memory, causing constant page swapping.

quiz_questions.question_text: Which algorithm is used for deadlock avoidance in multi-resource systems?
quiz_questions.explanation: Dijkstra's Banker's algorithm tests for safe states prior to granting resource requests.

quiz_questions.question_text: What system call is used in Unix-like systems to create a child process by duplicating the calling process?
quiz_questions.explanation: fork() creates an identical copy of the calling process address space.

quiz_questions.question_text: In mutual exclusion, what synchronization primitive provides a semaphore initialized to 1?
quiz_questions.explanation: A binary semaphore has values restricted to 0 and 1, functioning as a mutual exclusion lock.

quiz_questions.question_text: Which page replacement algorithm suffers from Belady’s anomaly?
quiz_questions.explanation: Under FIFO page replacement, increasing page frames can paradoxically increase page faults.

quiz_questions.question_text: What mechanism prevents low-priority processes from starving indefinitely in priority scheduling?
quiz_questions.explanation: Aging gradually increases process priority as it waits in the ready queue.

quiz_questions.question_text: What is a race condition in concurrent programming?
quiz_questions.explanation: A race condition occurs when concurrent threads access shared data without proper synchronization.

quiz_questions.question_text: What table maps logical page numbers to physical page frames?
quiz_questions.explanation: The Page Table maintains the mapping between virtual pages and physical memory frames.

quiz_questions.question_text: Which algorithmic paradigm does Kruskal’s Minimum Spanning Tree algorithm use?
quiz_questions.explanation: Kruskal’s algorithm greedily chooses the smallest edge that does not form a cycle.

quiz_questions.question_text: What complexity class contains decision problems verifiable in polynomial time by a deterministic Turing machine?
quiz_questions.explanation: NP consists of decision problems whose solutions can be verified in polynomial time.

quiz_questions.question_text: What is the tightest asymptotic upper bound representation?
quiz_questions.explanation: Big O characterizes the asymptotic upper bound of an algorithm.

quiz_questions.question_text: What is the optimal substructure property in dynamic programming?
quiz_questions.explanation: Optimal substructure means optimal solutions to subproblems combine into an overall optimal solution.

quiz_questions.question_text: What is the recurrence relation for the Tower of Hanoi problem with n disks?
quiz_questions.explanation: Moving n disks requires moving n-1 disks twice plus 1 move for the largest disk: 2T(n-1) + 1.

quiz_questions.question_text: What is the time complexity of the Floyd-Warshall all-pairs shortest path algorithm?
quiz_questions.explanation: Floyd-Warshall uses three nested loops over all vertices, giving O(V^3).

quiz_questions.question_text: Which problem was the first proven to be NP-Complete (Cook-Levin theorem)?
quiz_questions.explanation: The Cook-Levin theorem established that the Boolean Satisfiability Problem (SAT) is NP-Complete.

quiz_questions.question_text: What data structure is used to optimize Prim’s algorithm to O(E log V) time?
quiz_questions.explanation: A priority queue (binary or Fibonacci heap) allows fast min-edge extraction.

quiz_questions.question_text: In the Master Theorem for divide-and-conquer, T(n) = 2T(n/2) + O(n) resolves to what complexity?
quiz_questions.explanation: By Case 2 of the Master Theorem (log_b(a) = log_2(2) = 1), T(n) = Θ(n log n).

quiz_questions.question_text: Which algorithm solves the 0/1 Knapsack problem optimally?
quiz_questions.explanation: 0/1 Knapsack requires dynamic programming due to non-divisible discrete items.

quiz_questions.question_text: What layer of the OSI model does the Transport Layer Security (TLS) protocol operate at?
quiz_questions.explanation: TLS operates above the transport layer (TCP) to provide secure communications for application protocols.

quiz_questions.question_text: Which protocol translates domain names into IP addresses?
quiz_questions.explanation: Domain Name System (DNS) maps human-readable domain names to numerical IP addresses.

quiz_questions.question_text: What mechanism does TCP use to control sender transmission rate based on network congestion?
quiz_questions.explanation: TCP congestion control employs Slow Start, Congestion Avoidance, and Fast Recovery.

quiz_questions.question_text: Which routing protocol is an exterior gateway protocol used to route traffic across the global Internet?
quiz_questions.explanation: BGP is the de facto path-vector protocol managing inter-autonomous system routing.

quiz_questions.question_text: What is the length of an IPv6 address in bits?
quiz_questions.explanation: IPv6 uses 128-bit addresses compared to 32 bits for IPv4.

quiz_questions.question_text: Which asymmetric encryption algorithm relies on the mathematical difficulty of factoring large prime products?
quiz_questions.explanation: RSA security is based on the computational hardness of the integer factorization problem.

quiz_questions.question_text: What port does secure HTTP (HTTPS) operate on by default?
quiz_questions.explanation: Standard HTTPS traffic uses TCP port 443.

quiz_questions.question_text: Which protocol is used to map an IPv4 address to its physical hardware MAC address?
quiz_questions.explanation: ARP resolves network layer IPv4 addresses to link layer MAC addresses on the local segment.

quiz_questions.question_text: In a TCP three-way handshake, what is the order of packet flags exchanged?
quiz_questions.explanation: TCP connection establishment follows: Client SYN, Server SYN-ACK, Client ACK.

quiz_questions.question_text: What symmetric encryption algorithm is the current NIST standard worldwide?
quiz_questions.explanation: AES (Rijndael) is the federal standard for symmetric block cipher encryption.

quiz_questions.question_text: Which activation function maps real numbers to the range (0, 1) and is commonly used for binary classification output?
quiz_questions.explanation: The Sigmoid function 1 / (1 + e^-z) outputs probabilities in the range (0, 1).

quiz_questions.question_text: What problem does the Rectified Linear Unit (ReLU) activation function help alleviate in deep networks?
quiz_questions.explanation: ReLU has constant derivative 1 for positive inputs, reducing vanishing gradients.

quiz_questions.question_text: In unsupervised learning, what algorithm partitions n observations into k clusters around centroids?
quiz_questions.explanation: K-Means partitions data points into k distinct clusters by minimizing inertia to centroids.

quiz_questions.question_text: What technique prevents overfitting by adding a penalty proportional to the magnitude of weights (L2 norm)?
quiz_questions.explanation: L2 Ridge regularization penalizes the squared Euclidean norm of weights.

quiz_questions.question_text: What is the primary objective of Backpropagation in neural networks?
quiz_questions.explanation: Backpropagation applies the calculus chain rule to calculate loss gradients efficiently.

quiz_questions.question_text: Which metric measures the fraction of true positive predictions among all positive calls made by the model?
quiz_questions.explanation: Precision = TP / (TP + FP), indicating the purity of positive predictions.

quiz_questions.question_text: In reinforcement learning, what equation defines the optimal state-value function recursively?
quiz_questions.explanation: The Bellman optimality equation expresses the value of a state as expected immediate reward plus discounted future value.

quiz_questions.question_text: What is the Curse of Dimensionality in machine learning?
quiz_questions.explanation: In high-dimensional space, data volume grows exponentially, causing extreme sparsity and geometric distortion.

quiz_questions.question_text: Which machine learning model finds the optimal hyperplane that maximizes the margin between classes?
quiz_questions.explanation: SVM constructs maximum-margin separating hyperplanes.

quiz_questions.question_text: What neural architecture uses self-attention mechanisms to process sequential data in parallel?
quiz_questions.explanation: Transformers rely entirely on self-attention mechanisms without recurrence.

quiz_questions.question_text: What does Kirchhoff’s Current Law (KCL) state regarding any electrical junction node?
quiz_questions.explanation: KCL is a manifestation of conservation of electric charge.

quiz_questions.question_text: What is the barrier potential of a standard silicon PN junction diode at room temperature (approx 300K)?
quiz_questions.explanation: Silicon diodes typically have a forward barrier potential of approximately 0.7V.

quiz_questions.question_text: According to Thevenin’s Theorem, any linear two-terminal circuit can be replaced by:
quiz_questions.explanation: Thevenin equivalent consists of V_th in series with R_th.

quiz_questions.question_text: What is the unit of electrical capacitance in the SI system?
quiz_questions.explanation: Capacitance is measured in Farads (coulombs per volt).

quiz_questions.question_text: What device operates in the reverse breakdown region to provide stable voltage regulation?
quiz_questions.explanation: Zener diodes are engineered to conduct in reverse breakdown with near-constant voltage.

quiz_questions.question_text: What is the relationship between frequency f and angular frequency ω in AC circuits?
quiz_questions.explanation: Angular frequency in radians per second is given by ω = 2πf.

quiz_questions.question_text: What theorem states that maximum power is transferred to a load when load resistance equals Thevenin resistance?
quiz_questions.explanation: Maximum power transfer occurs when R_L = R_th in DC resistive circuits.

quiz_questions.question_text: What is the current gain factor β in a Common-Emitter BJT transistor configuration?
quiz_questions.explanation: Beta (β) is the DC current gain defined as collector current divided by base current.

quiz_questions.question_text: What type of filter allows frequencies below a cutoff frequency and attenuates higher frequencies?
quiz_questions.explanation: A Low-Pass Filter transmits low-frequency signals while suppressing high frequencies.

quiz_questions.question_text: What is the ideal input impedance of an operational amplifier?
quiz_questions.explanation: An ideal op-amp exhibits infinite input impedance, drawing zero input current.

quiz_questions.question_text: Which logic gate produces a HIGH output only when both of its inputs are distinct (different)?
quiz_questions.explanation: Exclusive-OR (XOR) outputs 1 when inputs are unequal (0,1 or 1,0).

quiz_questions.question_text: Which pair of logic gates are known as Universal Gates because any Boolean logic can be constructed using them?
quiz_questions.explanation: NAND and NOR can synthesize any arbitrary Boolean function independently.

quiz_questions.question_text: According to De Morgan’s theorem, (A + B)’ is algebraically equal to:
quiz_questions.explanation: De Morgan’s law states the complement of a sum equals the product of the complements.

quiz_questions.question_text: What is the primary function of a multiplexer (MUX)?
quiz_questions.explanation: A Multiplexer (data selector) routes one of 2^n inputs to a single output using n select lines.

quiz_questions.question_text: In a JK flip-flop, what output behavior occurs when both J and K inputs are set to logic HIGH (1)?
quiz_questions.explanation: When J=1 and K=1, the output toggles on every clock pulse.

quiz_questions.question_text: How many flip-flops are required to construct a MOD-16 synchronous counter?
quiz_questions.explanation: 2^n >= 16 requires n = 4 flip-flops.

quiz_questions.question_text: What is the Gray code equivalent of binary 1010?
quiz_questions.explanation: Binary to Gray: MSB unchanged (1), then XOR adjacent bits: 1 XOR 0 = 1, 0 XOR 1 = 1, 1 XOR 0 = 1 -> 1111.

quiz_questions.question_text: What circuit adds three binary bits (two significant bits and one incoming carry)?
quiz_questions.explanation: A Full Adder adds A, B, and Carry-in producing Sum and Carry-out.

quiz_questions.question_text: What is the resolution of an 8-bit digital-to-analog converter with 5V full-scale reference?
quiz_questions.explanation: Resolution is V_ref / (2^n - 1) = 5 / 255 = 19.6 mV.

quiz_questions.question_text: What type of memory loses its stored contents immediately when power is disconnected?
quiz_questions.explanation: Volatile RAM requires continuous electrical power to maintain bit state.

quiz_questions.question_text: What is the width of the external address bus in the 8086 microprocessor, and what maximum memory can it address?
quiz_questions.explanation: The 8086 has a 20-bit address bus allowing 2^20 = 1,048,576 bytes (1 MB) address space.

quiz_questions.question_text: In 8086 segmentation, how is the physical 20-bit memory address calculated from Segment and Offset registers?
quiz_questions.explanation: Physical address = (Segment * 16) + Offset, which shifts segment 4 bits left.

quiz_questions.question_text: Which register in 8086 serves as the default Loop Counter in loop instructions?
quiz_questions.explanation: The Count register (CX) is automatically decremented by the LOOP instruction.

quiz_questions.question_text: What type of interrupt in 8086 cannot be disabled or masked by software (via CLI instruction)?
quiz_questions.explanation: NMI is a dedicated hardware pin that cannot be masked by the Interrupt Flag.

quiz_questions.question_text: In the 8051 microcontroller, how many 8-bit bidirectional I/O ports are available?
quiz_questions.explanation: The 8051 has four 8-bit parallel I/O ports: P0, P1, P2, and P3.

quiz_questions.question_text: What is the size of the on-chip internal RAM in the standard 8051 microcontroller?
quiz_questions.explanation: Standard 8051 features 128 bytes of internal scratchpad RAM.

quiz_questions.question_text: What architecture distinguishes microcontrollers with separate instruction and data memory buses?
quiz_questions.explanation: Harvard architecture employs physically separate memories and buses for instructions and data.

quiz_questions.question_text: In ARM Cortex-M processors, what is the primary exception handler vector controller?
quiz_questions.explanation: NVIC provides low-latency, deterministic interrupt handling for ARM Cortex-M.

quiz_questions.question_text: What register in 8086 holds the status condition flags (Zero, Carry, Sign, Overflow)?
quiz_questions.explanation: The 16-bit FLAGS register stores conditional and control status flags.

quiz_questions.question_text: Which communication protocol uses two wires: SCL (Serial Clock) and SDA (Serial Data)?
quiz_questions.explanation: I2C uses two bidirectional open-drain lines: Serial Clock and Serial Data.

quiz_questions.question_text: What is Common Mode Rejection Ratio (CMRR) in differential operational amplifiers?
quiz_questions.explanation: CMRR measures an amplifier’s ability to reject common-mode noise.

quiz_questions.question_text: In an inverting op-amp configuration with R1 = 10kΩ and Rf = 100kΩ, what is the closed-loop voltage gain?
quiz_questions.explanation: Inverting gain A_v = -Rf / R1 = -100k / 10k = -10.

quiz_questions.question_text: What is the maximum rate of change of output voltage per unit time in an op-amp called?
quiz_questions.explanation: Slew rate (typically in V/μs) defines the maximum output voltage rate of change.

quiz_questions.question_text: What type of multivibrator generates continuous square-wave oscillations without an external trigger?
quiz_questions.explanation: An astable multivibrator has no stable states and continuously oscillates.

quiz_questions.question_text: In a 555 timer IC, what fraction of Vcc sets the upper internal threshold voltage comparator?
quiz_questions.explanation: The internal 3x 5kΩ resistor ladder sets the upper threshold at 2/3 Vcc.

quiz_questions.question_text: Which active filter topology uses a single op-amp with two resistors and two capacitors to yield a second-order response?
quiz_questions.explanation: Sallen-Key is the widely used single op-amp second-order active filter topology.

quiz_questions.question_text: What virtual concept occurs at an op-amp’s inverting terminal when the non-inverting terminal is tied to 0V ground?
quiz_questions.explanation: Due to infinite open-loop gain and zero differential voltage, the inverting terminal is at virtual ground.

quiz_questions.question_text: What circuit produces an output proportional to the mathematical integral of the input signal?
quiz_questions.explanation: An op-amp with a feedback capacitor performs analog integration of the input voltage.

quiz_questions.question_text: What Barkhausen criterion must be satisfied for sustained sinusoidal oscillations?
quiz_questions.explanation: Barkhausen criteria require loop gain magnitude unity and total loop phase shift zero.

quiz_questions.question_text: What type of feedback is applied in precision amplifier circuits to stabilize gain and widen bandwidth?
quiz_questions.explanation: Negative feedback trades raw gain for gain stability, linearity, and extended bandwidth.

quiz_questions.question_text: According to the Nyquist Sampling Theorem, what minimum sampling frequency f_s prevents aliasing for bandwidth W?
quiz_questions.explanation: Nyquist rate dictates sampling at least twice the maximum signal frequency.

quiz_questions.question_text: How many bits per symbol are transmitted in a 16-QAM modulation scheme?
quiz_questions.explanation: 16-QAM transmits log2(16) = 4 bits per constellation symbol.

quiz_questions.question_text: What filter maximizes the output signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) in the presence of additive white Gaussian noise?
quiz_questions.explanation: A matched filter is the optimal linear filter maximizing peak SNR in AWGN.

quiz_questions.question_text: What type of noise is introduced when continuous analog amplitudes are rounded to discrete levels in PCM?
quiz_questions.explanation: Quantization error arises from rounding continuous sample values to the nearest quantization level.

quiz_questions.question_text: What line coding scheme uses positive, zero, and negative voltage pulses to eliminate DC baseline wander?
quiz_questions.explanation: Bipolar AMI alternates positive and negative polarities for successive binary 1s.

quiz_questions.question_text: What is the theoretical Shannon channel capacity formula for a bandwidth B and signal-to-noise ratio S/N?
quiz_questions.explanation: The Shannon-Hartley theorem states C = B * log2(1 + SNR).

quiz_questions.question_text: In QPSK (Quadrature Phase Shift Keying), what is the phase difference between adjacent constellation points?
quiz_questions.explanation: QPSK has 4 symbols spaced 90 degrees apart in the I-Q plane.

quiz_questions.question_text: What error-correcting code adds parity check bits calculated using generator matrices and syndrome decoding?
quiz_questions.explanation: Linear block codes map message vectors to codewords via a generator matrix G.

quiz_questions.question_text: What phenomenon causes overlapping of successive pulses due to dispersive channel bandlimiting?
quiz_questions.explanation: ISI occurs when adjacent transmitted pulses spread out and interfere with one another.

quiz_questions.question_text: What pulse shape satisfies the Nyquist criterion for zero Intersymbol Interference?
quiz_questions.explanation: Raised cosine filters provide zero ISI at uniform symbol sampling instances.

quiz_questions.question_text: What formula gives dynamic switching power dissipation in a digital CMOS logic gate?
quiz_questions.explanation: Dynamic power P_dyn is proportional to load capacitance, frequency, and square of supply voltage.

quiz_questions.question_text: In a standard static CMOS inverter, which transistor pulls the output node HIGH to Vdd?
quiz_questions.explanation: PMOS transistors conduct when gate input is 0, pulling output up to Vdd.

quiz_questions.question_text: Why are PMOS transistors sized approximately 2 to 3 times wider than NMOS transistors in CMOS design?
quiz_questions.explanation: Electron mobility μ_n is 2-3 times higher than hole mobility μ_p, requiring wider PMOS channels for symmetric drive.

quiz_questions.question_text: What parasitic effect causes a parasitic thyristor (PNPN) in CMOS to turn on, creating a low-impedance short circuit?
quiz_questions.explanation: Latch-up is caused by parasitic bipolar transistors forming a silicon-controlled rectifier between Vdd and GND.

quiz_questions.question_text: What fabrication rule set specifies scalable minimum geometry dimensions using a parameter λ (lambda)?
quiz_questions.explanation: Mead-Conway lambda-based rules allow linear geometric scaling across CMOS processes.

quiz_questions.question_text: What is the logical effort of a standard static CMOS inverter?
quiz_questions.explanation: By convention, a standard CMOS inverter is defined to have a logical effort g = 1.

quiz_questions.question_text: What timing parameter defines the minimum time data must remain stable before the active clock edge?
quiz_questions.explanation: Setup time is the required stable duration before the clock edge to avoid metastability.

quiz_questions.question_text: What hardware element in FPGAs implements arbitrary n-input Boolean logic functions?
quiz_questions.explanation: SRAM-based Look-Up Tables (LUTs) implement truth tables for custom combinational logic.

quiz_questions.question_text: What short-channel effect causes threshold voltage to decrease as channel length decreases?
quiz_questions.explanation: DIBL occurs when drain depletion region reduces the source-channel potential barrier.

quiz_questions.question_text: In stick diagrams, what standard color represents polysilicon gate material?
quiz_questions.explanation: Polysilicon is universally represented by red lines in VLSI stick diagrams.

quiz_questions.question_text: What theorem states that if three coplanar concurrent forces keep a body in equilibrium, each force is proportional to the sine of the angle between the other two forces?
quiz_questions.explanation: Lami's theorem relates three coplanar, concurrent equilibrium forces using sine ratios.

quiz_questions.question_text: What is the relationship between the coefficient of static friction (μ_s) and the angle of friction (θ)?
quiz_questions.explanation: The coefficient of friction equals the tangent of the angle of friction.

quiz_questions.question_text: Where is the centroid of a right-angled triangle with base b and height h located from its base?
quiz_questions.explanation: The centroid of a right triangle is at one-third height from the base.

quiz_questions.question_text: What is the moment of inertia of a solid circular cross-section of diameter d about its centroidal axis?
quiz_questions.explanation: For a solid circle, I_xx = (π * d^4) / 64.

quiz_questions.question_text: According to Newton’s second law of motion, what is net force equal to for a system with constant mass?
quiz_questions.explanation: F = m * a where mass is constant.

quiz_questions.question_text: What theorem allows the calculation of moment of inertia about any parallel axis separated by distance d?
quiz_questions.explanation: Parallel Axis Theorem states I = I_G + m * d^2.

quiz_questions.question_text: What is the SI unit of torque or moment of a force?
quiz_questions.explanation: Torque is the cross product of position vector and force, measured in N·m.

quiz_questions.question_text: What is a truss structure called if the number of members m and joints j satisfy m = 2j - 3?
quiz_questions.explanation: m = 2j - 3 is the determinacy condition for a stable, statically determinate planar truss.

quiz_questions.question_text: What is the work done on a body when the displacement is perpendicular to the applied force vector?
quiz_questions.explanation: Work W = F * d * cos(90°) = 0.

quiz_questions.question_text: What type of collision conserves both linear momentum and total kinetic energy?
quiz_questions.explanation: In an elastic collision, total kinetic energy and linear momentum are conserved.

quiz_questions.question_text: Which law of thermodynamics defines the concept of temperature and provides the basis for thermometry?
quiz_questions.explanation: The Zeroth law establishes thermal equilibrium transitivity.

quiz_questions.question_text: What is the theoretical maximum thermal efficiency of a Carnot heat engine operating between temperatures T_H and T_L?
quiz_questions.explanation: Carnot efficiency η = 1 - (T_L / T_H), where temperatures are in Kelvin.

quiz_questions.question_text: In fluid mechanics, which dimensionless number characterizes the ratio of inertial forces to viscous forces?
quiz_questions.explanation: Reynolds Number Re = (ρ * v * D) / μ determines laminar vs turbulent flow regimes.

quiz_questions.question_text: Bernoulli’s equation for steady incompressible frictionless flow expresses the conservation of:
quiz_questions.explanation: Bernoulli’s equation relates pressure, kinetic, and potential energy heads along a streamline.

quiz_questions.question_text: What thermodynamic process takes place at constant pressure?
quiz_questions.explanation: Isobaric signifies constant pressure (dP = 0).

quiz_questions.question_text: What property of a thermodynamic system remains constant during a reversible adiabatic process?
quiz_questions.explanation: A reversible adiabatic process is isentropic (dS = 0).

quiz_questions.question_text: What device measures the stagnation pressure to calculate flow velocity of a fluid in pipe or flight?
quiz_questions.explanation: Pitot tubes measure total pressure, yielding dynamic pressure and fluid speed.

quiz_questions.question_text: What is the critical Reynolds number for transition from laminar to turbulent flow in a circular pipe?
quiz_questions.explanation: Internal pipe flow transitions to turbulent above Re ≈ 2300.

quiz_questions.question_text: What is the SI unit of dynamic viscosity (μ)?
quiz_questions.explanation: Dynamic viscosity is measured in Pascal-seconds (Pa·s).

quiz_questions.question_text: According to the Kelvin-Planck statement of the Second Law of Thermodynamics, it is impossible to construct a device that:
quiz_questions.explanation: Kelvin-Planck states that a 100% efficient heat engine operating on a single reservoir is impossible.

quiz_questions.question_text: In First Angle Projection, where is the Top View positioned relative to the Front View?
quiz_questions.explanation: In first angle projection, the top view is projected onto the bottom horizontal plane below the front view.

quiz_questions.question_text: What is the angle between the three principal isometric axes in isometric projection?
quiz_questions.explanation: In isometric projection, all three principal coordinate axes are inclined at 120 degrees to each other.

quiz_questions.question_text: What ratio describes isometric length to true true length (isometric scale factor)?
quiz_questions.explanation: Isometric scale foreshortens true dimensions by cos(30°)/cos(45°) * (1/√2) = √(2/3) ≈ 0.816.

quiz_questions.question_text: What line type is standardized in technical engineering drawings to represent hidden edges and contours?
quiz_questions.explanation: Dashed thin lines denote hidden features, surfaces, and outlines.

quiz_questions.question_text: What type of section view shows an object with one quarter cut away to reveal internal features?
quiz_questions.explanation: A half section passes cutting planes halfway through, exposing one half of internal details.

quiz_questions.question_text: In CAD software, what geometric constraint forces two circles to share the exact same center point?
quiz_questions.explanation: Concentric constraints lock arcs or circles to a shared center coordinate.

quiz_questions.question_text: What 3D CAD modeling operation creates a solid by sweeping an open or closed 2D profile along a guide path?
quiz_questions.explanation: Sweeping translates a 2D cross-section profile along a specified trajectory spine.

quiz_questions.question_text: What curve is traced by a point on the circumference of a circle rolling without slipping along a straight line?
quiz_questions.explanation: A cycloid is generated by rolling a generating circle along a straight directing line.

quiz_questions.question_text: What standard hatching angle is used for sectional views on engineering drawings?
quiz_questions.explanation: Section lines are traditionally drawn as thin continuous parallel lines at 45 degrees.

quiz_questions.question_text: What projection plane is perpendicular to both the horizontal and vertical projection planes?
quiz_questions.explanation: The Profile Plane is perpendicular to both reference planes and displays side views.

quiz_questions.question_text: Which law states that the rate of heat conduction through a material is proportional to the negative temperature gradient?
quiz_questions.explanation: Fourier's Law states Q = -k * A * (dT/dx).

quiz_questions.question_text: According to the Stefan-Boltzmann law, the total emissive power of a blackbody is proportional to what power of absolute temperature?
quiz_questions.explanation: Emissive power E_b = σ * T^4 where σ is the Stefan-Boltzmann constant.

quiz_questions.question_text: Which dimensionless number represents the ratio of convective to conductive heat transfer across a fluid boundary?
quiz_questions.explanation: Nusselt number Nu = (h * L) / k measures the enhancement of heat transfer by convection.

quiz_questions.question_text: What is thermal diffusivity defined as in transient heat conduction?
quiz_questions.explanation: Thermal diffusivity α = k / (ρ * c_p) represents the rate of heat diffusion through a medium.

quiz_questions.question_text: What device enhances heat transfer from a surface to surrounding fluid by increasing effective surface area?
quiz_questions.explanation: Fins are extended conductive surfaces engineered to augment convective heat dissipation.

quiz_questions.question_text: In counter-flow heat exchangers compared to parallel-flow heat exchangers for identical inlet/outlet temperatures, the LMTD is:
quiz_questions.explanation: Counter-flow provides a higher Log Mean Temperature Difference (LMTD) and superior heat transfer efficiency.

quiz_questions.question_text: What dimensionless number indicates whether temperature gradients inside a solid are negligible during transient heating/cooling (Bi < 0.1)?
quiz_questions.explanation: When Biot number Bi = (h * L_c) / k < 0.1, lumped capacitance spatial uniformity can be assumed.

quiz_questions.question_text: What physical law dictates that the wavelength of maximum radiation emission from a blackbody is inversely proportional to temperature?
quiz_questions.explanation: Wien's law states λ_max * T = 2898 μm·K.

quiz_questions.question_text: What fluid heat transfer regime occurs strictly due to density differences induced by temperature gradients without external fans or pumps?
quiz_questions.explanation: Natural convection is driven entirely by buoyancy forces arising from fluid density differentials.

quiz_questions.question_text: What is the critical radius of insulation for a circular cylinder with thermal conductivity k and convective coefficient h?
quiz_questions.explanation: For a cylinder, the critical radius of insulation maximizing heat loss is r_cr = k / h.

quiz_questions.question_text: What ideal thermodynamic air-standard power cycle represents the working cycle of a spark-ignition (petrol) engine?
quiz_questions.explanation: The Otto cycle features constant-volume heat addition and heat rejection.

quiz_questions.question_text: In a Diesel cycle, how is heat added to the working fluid?
quiz_questions.explanation: The ideal Diesel cycle assumes constant-pressure heat addition.

quiz_questions.question_text: What ideal thermodynamic gas power cycle serves as the model for modern aircraft jet engines and gas turbine power plants?
quiz_questions.explanation: The open/closed Brayton cycle models continuous gas turbine compressors, combustion chambers, and turbines.

quiz_questions.question_text: For the same compression ratio and heat input, what is the correct ordering of theoretical thermal efficiencies?
quiz_questions.explanation: At the same compression ratio, heat addition at constant volume gives higher thermal efficiency: Otto > Dual > Diesel.

quiz_questions.question_text: What parameter is defined as the ratio of clearance volume to swept (displacement) volume?
quiz_questions.explanation: Clearance ratio c = V_c / V_s.

quiz_questions.question_text: What component in a steam power plant condenses turbine exhaust steam into liquid water at low pressure?
quiz_questions.explanation: The condenser condenses exhaust steam, maintaining vacuum conditions to maximize turbine expansion work.

quiz_questions.question_text: What modification in a Brayton gas turbine cycle uses exhaust gases to preheat compressed air before the combustor?
quiz_questions.explanation: Regeneration extracts thermal energy from turbine exhaust to preheat combustor inlet air.

quiz_questions.question_text: What is the function of an economizer in a high-pressure boiler system?
quiz_questions.explanation: An economizer recovers heat from flue gas to preheat feedwater before it enters the boiler drum.

quiz_questions.question_text: What ratio compares the actual indicated work of an engine to the fuel energy supplied?
quiz_questions.explanation: Indicated thermal efficiency measures how effectively fuel combustion heat is converted to work inside cylinders.

quiz_questions.question_text: What device connects multi-stage compressors to reduce air temperature between compression stages toward isothermal work?
quiz_questions.explanation: Intercooling cools gas between compression stages, minimizing total required compressor work.

quiz_questions.question_text: How many Denavit-Hartenberg (D-H) parameters are required to relate any two consecutive coordinate frames in an open serial kinematic chain?
quiz_questions.explanation: D-H convention uses four parameters: link length (a), link twist (α), link offset (d), and joint angle (θ).

quiz_questions.question_text: What is the kinematic problem of determining end-effector position and orientation given known joint angles called?
quiz_questions.explanation: Forward kinematics maps joint space angles to Cartesian task space pose.

quiz_questions.question_text: What mathematical matrix relates joint velocities (q-dot) to Cartesian linear and angular end-effector velocities (x-dot)?
quiz_questions.explanation: The Jacobian matrix J(q) defines the linear mapping between joint velocities and end-effector velocities.

quiz_questions.question_text: What kinematic condition occurs when the robot Jacobian matrix loses rank (det(J) = 0), causing loss of one or more degrees of freedom?
quiz_questions.explanation: At singular configurations, the manipulator loses mobility along one or more directions.

quiz_questions.question_text: What industrial robot joint configuration is denoted by SCARA?
quiz_questions.explanation: SCARA robots provide selective compliance in the horizontal XY plane while maintaining vertical Z rigidity.

quiz_questions.question_text: In Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs), what graphical programming language uses rungs, contacts, and coils resembling relay schematics?
quiz_questions.explanation: Ladder Diagram is the most widely adopted IEC 61131-3 graphical programming language in industrial automation.

quiz_questions.question_text: What sensor provides optical feedback of rotational position and speed by detecting pulse transitions on a slotted disc?
quiz_questions.explanation: Incremental or absolute optical rotary encoders deliver precise digital angular position feedback.

quiz_questions.question_text: What term describes the complete geometric volume reachable by the robot end-effector?
quiz_questions.explanation: The workspace defines the set of all spatial points the end-effector can access.

quiz_questions.question_text: In PID control systems, what term eliminates steady-state tracking error by accumulating past error over time?
quiz_questions.explanation: The integral controller continuously sums offset error, driving steady-state error to zero.

quiz_questions.question_text: What industrial communication protocol standard operates over RS-485 serial communication in Master-Slave architecture?
quiz_questions.explanation: Modbus RTU is the industry-standard serial communication protocol over differential RS-485 lines.

quiz_questions.question_text: Which ACID property guarantees transactional durability?
quiz_questions.explanation: Durability ensures committed transactions survive system crashes.

quiz_questions.question_text: In OS scheduling, which algorithm is non-preemptive?
quiz_questions.explanation: First-Come, First-Served (FCFS) runs to completion.
